name: Exa Search
description: Replace HanaAgent's built-in web_search (Tavily/Brave/Serper) with Exa's neural search engine. Removes web_search from the LLM tool list and registers exa_search instead, with automatic fallback to web_search when Exa fails.

exaApiKey.title: Exa API Key
exaApiKey.description: Get one at https://exa.ai (free tier: 1000 searches/month).
